generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years

As a documentary proof of the above, copies of Work order and Work Done certificate for executing as a Prime Contractor in a single work order for an amount not less than Rs.46.90 Lakhs (excluding GST) issued by competent authority in any one year of the Preceding five financial years i.e.,2021-22 to 2025-26 shall be furnished. On demand originals shall be produced for verification. Cost of work executed in previous years shall be given 10% of weightage per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which the tenders are invited.

The Bidder should be a regular Agency/Contractor/Firm with Class-I or above Electrical License issued by Electrical Inspectorate & should have proven experience in the field of Routine/Breakdown maintenance of 415V and above electrical distribution system, switchgear, plant illumination and overhead HT/LT line system works.

The Bidder should have achieved an average Annual Financial Turnover of Rs. 93.8 Lakhs in any two of the preceding FIVE financial years (i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26). Scanned copies of Annual Turnover certificate (i.e Profit and Loss statement) with Unique Document Identification Number(UDIN) certified by chartered accountant should be enclosed as a documentary proof. On demand original shall be produced for verification. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given 10% of weightage per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which the tenders are invited
